recipes.interpretation: Nonlinear harmonic change rather than merely louder output
recipes.mechanism: Transfer-curve knee inside the actual driven amplitude range
recipes.expected: Gain-compensated residual and relative harmonics change beyond unchanged-repeat differences
recipes.validation: Real initial curve was only+12.34dB gain/residual−74.19dB; revised reachable knee gave residual−7.78dB and changed Hn/H1
recipes.failure: Only louder; phase/latency/randomness confounds residual; harshness/aliasing not established by one scalar
recipes.fallback: Restore baseline, bring knee into range or use gentler curve; repeat fixed note and actual context before selecting

recipes.word: 空灵 空间 回声

recipes.fallback: Measure an isolated pulse; reduce feedback/wet or change rhythmic spacing; report arrangement conflicts instead of changing protected parts
